rationale: No supported optimization is missing from this workflow. The job already bounds execution with timeout-minutes: 5 (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT already applied; no representative duration history exists to retune it, and ci_history shows no completed runs). It already caches pip dependencies (~/.cache/pip keyed on hashFiles('requirements/*.txt')) and pre-commit virtualenvs, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated by its own "An equivalent cache already exists" rule. The remaining patterns do not apply: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST), no schedule (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), a single reusable workflow_call job with no tests to select/prioritize (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER, P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT), no Bazel (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), no history for timeout derivation (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT), and no identified unused output or verified config smell to remove (P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS, P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR). The change preserves all build/test coverage and adds no secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment steps, or new network access.
